name: Liaoning Cheng Da Co., Ltd.
summary: Liaoning Cheng Da Co., Ltd. engages in pharmaceuticals and healthcare, financial investment, trading, and energy development businesses in China and internationally. The company is involved in the import and export of textiles, and clothing, as well as the trade of bulk commodities, such as coal, steel, and aquatic products; and oil shale mining, shale oil production, and sale business.
